task:
TASK: OpenCode Mobile YouTube Shorts — cut MORE Shorts from EXISTING footage only.

CONTEXT
- Find "OpenCode Mobile" Notion page (search Notion API tools: notion_API-post-search query "OpenCode Mobile"). Read it for: existing full journey footage location/links, the "Demo Registry" (list of already-recorded clips/footage files and their content), and the 1 Short already live (get its URL).
- Founder goal: 10x Shorts total. 1 already live -> need up to 9 more, but ONLY from footage that ALREADY EXISTS. Do NOT record new footage. This is a hard rule (Demo Registry rule).

STEPS
1. Read the Notion page fully (notion_API-retrieve-page-markdown). Locate the Demo Registry section and the full journey footage (video files/links, likely local paths under this repo or attached media).
2. Inventory available raw footage files. Identify distinct segments (moments) in the footage that are NOT already used in the 1 live Short, and that are self-contained enough to be a coherent 15-60s Short (e.g. distinct app features/flows demoed: connect to server, sessions list, new session, chat/coding task, settings, model picker, etc.)
3. For each usable segment, cut a short clip using ffmpeg (trim only, no re-recording, no new capture). Save outputs locally with clear filenames.
4. Upload each cut clip to YouTube as a Short via vibebrowser-cli, ONE browser tab total for the whole job:
   - Command: npx -y @vibebrowser/cli --remote wss://relay.api.vibebrowser.app/eb936443-00fc-4e18-9b5b-4b06c02b00d6
   - List tabs first, reuse/create exactly ONE tab, pass --page-id on every command.
   - Navigate to YouTube Studio upload flow, upload each clip as a Short (vertical framing if needed via ffmpeg crop/pad before upload), fill title/description, publish.
   - Close the tab when fully done with ALL uploads (not between uploads).
5. For each uploaded video, verify it's live via YouTube oEmbed: fetch https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=<video_url>&format=json and confirm HTTP 200 + valid title in response. This is the verification gate — do not list a link unless oEmbed succeeds.
6. Update the "OpenCode Mobile" Notion page: add a section listing all Shorts links (existing 1 + each new one), each with its oEmbed-verified title, and update the Demo Registry to mark footage segments as "used".
7. BE HONEST: if the existing footage genuinely supports fewer than 9 additional distinct Shorts (e.g. only 4 more coherent distinct segments exist), cut only that many. Do not pad the count with duplicate/near-duplicate content or filler. State the honest final count and why in your summary.

CONSTRAINTS
- No re-recording, no new screen capture — footage-only per Demo Registry rule.
- Exactly one browser tab for the whole session; close it after all uploads finish.
- Use github-copilot as the model provider for this work if you have model selection available.
- Do not ask the human anything — you have all tools needed (ffmpeg via bash, vibebrowser-cli, Notion MCP tools, webfetch for oEmbed).

RETURN TO ME (final message only):
- Honest count of new Shorts actually uploaded (vs the "9 more" target) and why that's the ceiling.
- List of all Short URLs (old + new) with oEmbed-verified titles.
- Confirmation the Notion page was updated with links + Demo Registry usage.
- Confirmation the browser tab was closed.
- Any footage gaps that would require NEW recording to reach 10x (do not act on this, just report).
